  ∀ H : { H : SimpleGraph V // H ≤ G }, ∃ q : Fin D → (V ≃ Fin N), ∀ x y, r H x y ↔ ∀ i, (q i x : Fin N) ≤ q i y :=
  by
  intro H
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := bspd_hexists_perm_realizer_of_poset_dimension N hN (hpo H)
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := …
obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := bspd_hexists_perm_pad q (hge1 H) (hleD H)
exact ⟨Q, fun x y => (hq x y).trans (hQ x y)⟩
set pad : { H : SimpleGraph V // H ≤ G } → (Fin D → (V ≃ Fin N)) := fun H => (hex H).choose with hpaddef
have hpad : ∀ H, ∀ x y, r H x y ↔ ∀ i, (pad H i x : Fin N) ≤ pad H i y := fun H => (hex H).choose_spec

have hpadinj : Function.Injective pad := by
  intro H H' hEq
  have hrr : ∀ x y, r H x y ↔ r H' x y := by
    intro x y
    have h1 := hpad H x y
    have h2 := hpad H' x y
    rw [hEq] at h1
    exact h1.trans h2.symm
  apply Subtype.ext
  …

have hrr : ∀ x y, r H x y ↔ r H' x y := by
  intro x y
  have h1 := hpad H x y
  have h2 := hpad H' x y
  rw [hEq] at h1
  exact h1.trans h2.symm
have h1 := hpad H x y
have h2 := hpad H' x y
exact bspd_heq_of_bipartite_poset_le_iff h_bip H.2 H'.2 hrr

have hbound : Fintype.card { H : SimpleGraph V // H ≤ G } ≤ Fintype.card (Fin D → (V ≃ Fin N)) :=
  Fintype.card_le_of_injective pad hpadinj

have hcardperm : Fintype.card (Fin D → (V ≃ Fin N)) = N.factorial ^ D :=
  by
  rw [Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_fin]
  obtain ⟨e⟩ : Nonempty (V ≃ Fin N) := ⟨(Fintype.equivFin V).trans (finCongr hN)⟩
  rw [Fintype.card_equiv e, hN]
obtain ⟨e⟩ : Nonempty (V ≃ Fin N) := ⟨(Fintype.equivFin V).trans (finCongr hN)⟩
have hMeq : 2 ^ M = Fintype.card { H : SimpleGraph V // H ≤ G } := by rw [bspd_hcard_subgraph_le G, hM]

obtain ⟨H₀, -, hH₀⟩ :=
  Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup (Finset.univ : Finset { H : SimpleGraph V // H ≤ G }) ⟨⟨⊥, bot_le⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
    (fun H : { H : SimpleGraph V // H ≤ G } => poset_dimension (r H))
have hDval : D = poset_dimension (r H₀) := by rw [hD]; exact hH₀

calc
  2 ^ M = Fintype.card { H : SimpleGraph V // H ≤ G } := hMeq
  _ ≤ Fintype.card (Fin D → (V ≃ Fin N)) := hbound
  _ = N.factorial ^ D := hcardperm
  _ = N.factorial ^ (poset_dimension (r H₀)) := by rw [hDval]
